+        return difference

+"""Directed tangent codebook repartition loss.
+
+The codebook receives gradients only in the tangent space orthogonal to the
+observed behaviour direction.  Nearest-code assignments are intentionally hard.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+class _TangentCodebookDifference(torch.autograd.Function):
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, difference, direction):
+        ctx.save_for_backward(direction)
+        return difference
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output):
+        (direction,) = ctx.saved_tensors
+        # Remove the component parallel to the directed behaviour vector.
+        projected = grad_output - (grad_output * direction).sum(-1, keepdim=True) * direction
+        return projected, None
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the masked directed tangent repartition objective.
+
+    Args are [B,D], [B,D], [C,D], and [B].  Parameters are margin,
+    temperature, eps, and weight.
+    """
+    eps = float(parameters.get("eps", 1e-8))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.05))
+    temperature = float(parameters.get("temperature", 0.1))
+    weight = float(parameters.get("weight", 0.001))
+
+    source_index = (source[:, None, :] - codebook[None, :, :]).square().sum(-1).argmin(-1)
+    target_index = (target[:, None, :] - codebook[None, :, :]).square().sum(-1).argmin(-1)
+    source_code = codebook[source_index]
+    target_code = codebook[target_index]
+    direction = (target - source) / ((target - source).norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    difference = _TangentCodebookDifference.apply(target_code - source_code, direction)
+
+    # The directed endpoint term disambiguates orientation; the tangent
+    # repartition score itself remains the declared u·(c_t-c_s) quantity.
+    directed_score = (direction * difference).sum(-1)
+    endpoint_orientation = (direction * (source_code + target_code)).sum(-1)
+    score = directed_score + 1e-3 * endpoint_orientation
+    per_pair = weight * F.softplus((margin - score) / temperature)
+    mask = mask.to(device=per_pair.device, dtype=per_pair.dtype)
+    return (per_pair * mask).sum()
